items.claim: Neil Magny has struggled with submission defense throughout his entire career.
items.quote: Magny has been struggling with submission defense throughout pretty much his entire career.

items.claim: Brahim Ma has underrated boxing skills.
items.quote: He does have underrated boxing in my opinion

items.claim: Lucas Fernando has great power and speed at light heavyweight.
items.quote: what he's brought up to 205 pounds is a very good level of power and a good level of speed.

items.claim: Rafael Tobias lacks athleticism, does not move his head, and is stiff on the feet.
items.quote: This guy has no sort of real level of athleticism. He doesn't move his head. He's stiff on the feet.

items.claim: Vicente Luque suffered a brain injury and has not looked like the same fighter since.
items.quote: He had a brain injury at some point as well around this period of time... and he just has not looked like the same guy since.
